text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: After Fubuki taught Vampy how to use the device, she took a selfie to post to the members-only Magic Stone Social Network.
text_block_list.orig_text:
フブキにデバイスの使い方を教えてもらったヴァンピィは、
会員制魔石交信網へ投稿するために自撮りをしていった。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Umm... How's this angle?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと～……
角度は、
こんな感じ？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Roooar~♪
text_block_list.orig_text: がおーっ♪

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, looks good♪ Lemme see... "To...day... I'm..."
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
いい感じ♪
ええっと……
き……
よ……
う……
は……

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: ...Done♪ Here♪ Post♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
できたっ♪
はい♪　
とーこー♪

text_block_list.name: Vampy's Post
text_block_list.text: At the pool with Bloodkin today♪
text_block_list.orig_text: 『きようは　げんそぐうと　ぷーる』

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...Ah♪ Bloodkin, look, look! I've already gotten three Loves♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ！
……あっ♪
　けんぞく、
見て見て！
もうラヴが３つもついたよっ♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Pffff... Ihihi♪ Do you think you've gone viral (lol) with just three posts? O'Strongest (lol) Vampy-chan... lol. Kyaahaha, so cute♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷーくすくす♪　
たった３つでバズった気ぃ？ｗ
さいきょー（笑）のヴァンピィちゃんｗ
きゃはっ、
かっわい～♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Mumumu... What about you, Fubuki?
text_block_list.orig_text:
むぅ……
そーゆーフブキはどーなの？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh? Want me to show you? lol
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～～ｗ
見せてもいーけどぉ？ｗ

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Wow, so many loves! Fubuki, you're amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ～、
ラヴがいっぱい！
フブキすごい！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Isn't that obvious? We're talking about me~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
とーぜんじゃん？ｗ
ぼくですし～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Relax, relax♡ Guys love this stuff, right? Cute girls in barely-there swimsuit shots♡ Besides, Onii-san, your nose is practically stretching to the floor~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
へーきへーき♡
　
ダンシって好きっしょ？
かわいージョシのギリギリ水着ショット♡
てかお兄さん、
鼻の下のびのびじゃ～ん？♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hey, is this post audio-only?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
こっちのとーこーは
音だけなの？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Those are getting pretty good reactions too♡ I'll let you hear it♪ Here you go, click~
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっちも評判いいカンジでーす♡
聞かせてあげる♪
ほい、
ポチっと♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki's Post
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, lol~ I bet you're listening to this secretly somewhere where no one's around, right? lol. You're such a loser, how pathetic, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『いひひｗ
これさ～
誰もいないとこで
コソコソしながら聞いてるんでしょ～？ｗ
ホントにザコでかわいそ～ｗ』

text_block_list.name: Fubuki's Post
text_block_list.text: For the sake of such a pathetic newb, I'll give you a special service lol. Come on, bring your ear closer...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『そんなかわいそーなザコのためにぃ、
ぼくが
トクベツサービスしてあげるよｗ
ほーら、
もっと耳近づけて──』

text_block_list.name: Fubuki's Post
text_block_list.text: Neeeeewb♡
text_block_list.orig_text: 『ざーこ♡』

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: ...Are there really people who love being called a loser or a "newb"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……『ざこ』っていわれて
うれしいひといるの？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So you really don't get it, do you, Vampy, lol. You seem like a well-to-do young lady, so you're totally clueless about how the world works, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヴァンピィにはわかんないよね～ｗ
なんかイイトコのお嬢サマっぽいし～
世間知らず丸出しってカンジ～ｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, just being a "goody-two-shoes" will get you buried in the competition within seconds. Check out the rankings.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
ってか、
ただの『いい子ちゃん』とか
秒で埋もれて終わりっしょ。
見てみーランキング。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: "Rankings"... what are those? How do I access them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
らんきんぐ、
ってなーに？
どうやるの？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Geez! Swipe the screen and tap that tab! There you go. ...At the top you've got the superstar model "Suzuna"... and the idol group "Carmina".
text_block_list.orig_text:
もー！
　画面スワイプしてそのタブ押す！
　はいそれ。
……ランキングの上位は、
カリスマモデルの『スズナ』。
トップアイドルの『カルミナ』。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: And then there's "Akino", who's shot up the rankings by showering everyone with giveaways. Do you understand now? The top spots are completely dominated by hot girls.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あとは、
派手なバラマキでどんどんランキングを駆け上がってきた
『アキノ』。
わかる？
トップは『イイ女』に独占されてんの。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: To even try to have a fair [rub:Competition]fight[/rub] with monsters like these is just plain stupid. "Playing fair" is something only ridiculously overpowered superstars, or complete idiots who can't think strategically, talk about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなバケモノどもとマトモに[rub:やる]勝負[/rub]とか、
ただのバカっしょ。
正攻法なんて言葉は、
ガチさいきょー無敵のカリスマか
頭使えんヤツのコトバって決まってんの。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: I'm cute, and I could probably win just with this cuteness, but there's no need for me to [rub:Compete]fight[/rub] head-on, right? I mean, isn't it best to pick the easiest way to win? So, I'm marketing myself as a "slightly bad girl"♡ It's all about strategy♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくかわいーし、
このかわいさだけでもまぁ[rub:やれ]勝負[/rub]っけど～
わざわざ正面からぶつかってく必要ねーし？
　てか
楽して勝ちたいし？
だから、
『ちょいワル女子』で売ってくってワケ♡　
戦略ってやーつ♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: ...Fubuki, so you've thought that far ahead. A strategy, huh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……フブキ、
そこまで考えてやってるんだ。
せんりゃく、
かぁ～……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hehe~♪ Vampy-chan, you're free to imitate me you know~ If you can, that is~
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ～ん♪
ヴァンピィちゃんもマネしていいよ～？
で・
き・
る・
な・
ら♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Something Vampy-chan can do... Hey, Fubuki, do you have any ideas?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん。
ヴァンピィちゃんにできること……
ね
ぇフブキ、
なんかアイデアなーい？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh? I don't know... Hmm, for example, can't you vampires use "Charm" on people?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？
　しらんけど……
んー、
たとえばー
吸血鬼って、
『魅了』できるんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: If you can "transmit" your magic through the device's circuitry, couldn't you make everyone fall head over heels for you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
デバイスの回路を通して、
マリョクを『デンパ』させちゃえば
みんなメロメロにできちゃうんじゃね？

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: "Transmit"...?
text_block_list.orig_text: でんぱ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: This device runs on magic stones. And the members-only Magic Stone Social Network is also built using an application of communication magic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このデバイスってさ、
魔石で動いてんの。
んで、
会員制魔石交信網も通信魔法の応用でできてるワケ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: The management has protected the communication-magic circuits... but if someone hijacked that transmission path... Ihihihi♡ You could send anything straight to the users devices themselves...
text_block_list.orig_text:
運営が通信魔法用の回路を保護してっけどー
その通り道をぼくが乗っ取れば……
いひひ♡
みんなのデバイスから直接持ち主に──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...! D-Don't make such a scary face! Whether something is technically possible and whether we'll actually do it are two completely different things, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ……！
　そ、
そんな怖い顔すんなしー！
技術的に可能なのと、
実際にやるかどーかなんて
全然別なハナシだし？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: In the first place~ Vampy-chan couldn't possibly do such a "naughty thing"~ lol
text_block_list.orig_text:
そもそもさ～。
ヴァンピィちゃんは、
そんな『ワルイコト』できないもんね～～～ｗ

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Winning by cheating like that wouldn't be satisfying! Vampy-chan will win with her "content"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなズルして勝ってもうれしくないし！
ヴァンピィちゃんは
『なかみ』でしょーぶしますのでー！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Well, good luck with that, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふーん？
ま、
がんばってーｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Uwaah, lol. Don't tell me she's one of those people who actually believes hard work gets rewarded? Lol. So naive, lol. She's so sugary-sweet she's giving me cavities just listening to her, lol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわーｗ　
ドリョクは報われるとか思っちゃってる系～？ｗ
マジ甘すぎｗ　
話してるだけで虫歯になっちゃいそ～ｗ

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: It's not that she doesn't understand how the world works, Vampy-chan's just a newbie♡ I guess I've won this match after all~♡ And then after that
text_block_list.orig_text:
げんじつを知らないっていうか、
ホントヴァンピィちゃんってザコ♡
この勝負、
やっぱぼくの勝ちで決まりだね～♡
んで、
そのあとは──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay~ I'm the winner of this match~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～い、
この勝負
ぼくの勝ち～♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Anyway, starting today, Newb Big Bro's going to be my toy and slave♡ I'm tired, so be my chair.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってことで、
ザコお兄さんは
今日からぼくのオモチャでドレーでぇ～す♡
それじゃあ早速、
ぼく疲れちゃったから、
イスになってくんない？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Whoa, lol. You're so hard. Worst chair ever♡ Oh, if you move, you'll be punished♡ But I don't recall chairs being able to move, so♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっわｗ　
硬くて座り心地わる～♡
あ、
動いたらオシオキね♡　
イスだから動くはずないもんね～♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Pffft... Ihihi♪ How does it feel to not be able to resist a girl smaller than you? Look, it's embarrassing with everyone watching, isn't it♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぷーくすくす♪
自分よりちっちゃい女の子に逆らえないってどんな気持ち？
ほらほら、
みんなに見られて恥ずかしいね～？♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! Even though he's Vampy-chan's Bloodkin~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわ～ん！
ヴァンピィちゃんのけんぞくなのに～！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ihihihi♡ Delish~♡♡♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
いひひひっ♡
さいっっっこ～♡♡♡

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: She's laughing all by herself... Fubuki's a weirdo.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひとりでわらってる……
へんなフブキ。

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Hey, I can't see your social profile anymore, Fubuki. There's some weird writing on it, too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
ねぇ、
フブキのとーこー、
見れなくなってるよ？
へんな文字も出てるし……

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Ah, here too. And there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
これも。
これもだ。

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: What's going on with my posts? I bet you just pressed something weird and caused some error, Vampy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくの投稿がなに？
どうせヴァンピィがまた変なとこ押してエラーでも──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki's Device Screen
text_block_list.text: The post in question has been removed due to a violation of our service policy.
text_block_list.orig_name: フブキのデバイス画面
text_block_list.orig_text:
『サービスポリシー違反のため、
該当する投稿を削除しました』

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: HUH?! My posts... THEY HAVE ALL BEEN DELETED?! WHAT'S GOING ON?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ！？
ぼくの投稿、
サクジョされてんですけど！？
どゆこと～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ping pong♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ピロンッ♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Scary... I got a message from the management...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こわ……
運営からメッセきたんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki's Device Screen
text_block_list.text: Due to confirmed violations, the planned incentive will be forfeited in full.
text_block_list.orig_name: フブキのデバイス画面
text_block_list.orig_text:
『違反行為が確認されたため、
予定されていたインセンティブは全額没収となります』

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: AAAAAHHHHHHHHHN?!
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁあああ～～～～っ！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: You've got to be kidding me...!? Not only did they delete my posts, they confiscated all my incentive money too?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ウソでしょっ……！？
投稿削除だけじゃなくて、
インセンティブも没収なの～～～！？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: SHITTY MANAGEMENT!!! QUIT DOING YOUR JOB PROPERLY! UWAAAAAH!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クソ運営ーーーっ！！！
マジメに仕事なんかしてんなよ～～～！
うわ～～ん！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. So cheating gets a "Bad!"♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん。
ズルは
『めっ！』
ってことなんだねー

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Well? That aside...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ？
それはそれとして～

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: So cold?! Please be nicer to me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
冷たぁっ！？
もっとぼくに優しくしろし～～～っ！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: A "Strategy"... Hmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
『せんりゃく』……
うーん……

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bloodkin. Do you have any good ideas that'd make Vampy-chan go viral?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
けんぞく。
ヴァンピィちゃんがバズれるよーな、
いいアイデア、
なーい？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Sniff... Hmph, what? You're just a scrub, so why're you acting like some hotshot producer? As if you could come up with a good plan so easily. Well then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐすっ……
ふんっ、
なに？
ザコお兄さんのくせにP気取りなワケ？
企画を立てるとか簡単に言うじゃん。
それならさ──

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: COME UP WITH A PLAN FOR ME TOO! Help me rack up Loves and incentives so I can beat Vampy! And then let me bully you like the total newb you are, you... big idiot... Uwaaaah~~~!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼくの企画考えてよ！
ぼくにラヴとインセンティブを稼がせて
ヴァンピィに勝たせて！
そんでザコお兄さんをザコザコにさせてよばかぁ～～～！！！

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Aaah, Fubuki! Vampy-chan asked first! Hey, hey, give Vampy-chan your best plan♪ You'll do it, right? Bloodkin~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～、
フブキ！
　ヴァンピィちゃんが先だったのに！
ね
ぇねぇ、
ヴァンピィちゃんの企画、
ちょーだい♪
いーでしょ～、
けんぞくぅ～♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Ugh, sniff... Onii-san...
text_block_list.orig_text: お兄さん……

text_block_list.name: Vampy
text_block_list.text: Bloodkiiin~♪
text_block_list.orig_text: けんぞくぅ～♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fubuki Vampy
text_block_list.text: A collab?!

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so, at {0}'s suggestion, the two did their first collaboration. Their dance video went massively viral, giving them a very promising start to the competition.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして{0}の提案により、
初コラボをした二人。
フブキとヴァンピィによるダンス動画が大バズりするという、
幸先のいいスタートが切られたのだった。
